paper_status: Article in Press / early accepted manuscript when retrieved
dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 (verified via Zenodo API metadata)

label_definitions.1b: Dimensionless initial substrate-depletion slope ratio, normalized to Ssal-KRED (FIO_Ssal-KRED). Clarified lysate assay. Must not be pooled as mM conversion or kcat.
label_definitions.2b_to_5b_R_and_S: Absolute product formation concentrations in mM after fixed time. Crude E.coli lysate assay with background from empty-vector control subtracted. 10 mM input substrate, 20 h at 20 C per README.
label_definitions.ee: Signed ee; positive values correspond to R preference in CSV. Values coded +/-100 correspond to opposite enantiomer undetected / >99% in publication, not proof of mathematically exactly pure material. Missing ee is not zero ee.
label_definitions.solubly_expressed: Expression/solubility phenotype; rows coded 0 have blank activity values and are not catalytic-negative labels.
label_definitions.melting_temperature: nanoDSF thermal melting temperature in C, not an activity label.

experimental_conditions.2a_5a_preparation: crude cell extracts from enzymatically lysed bacterial pellets
experimental_conditions.cofactor_regeneration: NADH/NADPH, glucose, GDH per README; concentrations and exact assay pH require SI
experimental_conditions.replicates: README states at least 3 independent replicates and SD where applicable. Summary CSVs lack replicate/SD fields; use Zenodo XLSX for uncertainty.
experimental_conditions.1a_kinetic_label: fold increase over Ssal-KRED, not purified-enzyme intrinsic activity

structural_evidence.reference: PDB 1Y1P WT cofactor complex per original JMB2005. Deposition uses covalently linked NMN+AMP+PO4 components, with explicit _struct_conn, rather than single NDP/NAP residue; do not mistake connected CCD fragments for absent cofactor.
structural_evidence.substrate_1a_pose: MOE2019.01 model, with 2.8 A contacts to Tyr177/Ser133 and 3.8 A constraint involving hydride-donor carbon stated in Fig2 caption; explicitly modeled and not experimental substrate geometry
structural_evidence.ortholog_models: Boltz-based computational structural workflow. Never count modeled orthologs as experimentally resolved ternary complexes.

chemical_identity_audits.finding: Source SMILES contains an alcohol C(O) at the intended reduction site, while Fig2c depicts a ketone C(=O). It resembles product rather than substrate.
chemical_identity_audits.curation_action: quarantine original chemical identity; do not silently use as ketone or overwrite source
chemical_identity_audits.evidence: Visual inspection of Fig2c vs Fig2d, main PDF p4.

chemical_identity_audits.finding: Source SMILES encodes 4-chloroacetoacetate carboxylate, but Fig2c explicitly depicts the ethyl ester ClCH2COCH2COOEt. Ethyl group and charge state are wrong for that depicted compound.
chemical_identity_audits.curation_action: quarantine until corrected with source-preserving provenance
chemical_identity_audits.evidence: Visual inspection of Fig2c main PDF p4.

additional_source_inconsistencies.finding: Narrative on p3 says ee99.3% for Ort-RDM-1; Fig2e on p4 shows86.6, matching CSV signed ee -86.6. Do not overwrite CSV with narrative99.3. Resolve against raw XLSX if this pair enters core.

allowed_current_use: Relative/activity ranking and sequence-substrate screening reference with explicit label separation and chemical audit. Not a drop-in experimental-complex geometry calibration set.
